title: Half Day Marble and Johnston Canyon Ice Walk Combo Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age to participate is 8 years old
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Visit two canyons, two national parks in two provinces with waters reaching two different oceans - all in one experience!

2 x 1-hour ice walks with a break to warm up in-between. Explore Johnston Canyon's famous catwalks surrounded by frozen waterfalls.

Visit secluded Marble Canyon, one of the deepest slot canyons in the Rockies.

Ice cleat rental, return transportation from Banff, hot chocolate and cookies included provided.
